steps.goal: Configure skin binding method and bind mesh to skeleton

actions.ui_element: Quick Rig > 5) Binding > Options Box Button
Bind Skin Options > Apply and Close

common_mistakes: Do not use Delete by Type > History on a bound mesh: it can remove the skin cluster, leaving the skeleton moving but the mesh stuck. Use Delete by Type > Non-Deformer History on a bound mesh instead. (community: Autodesk Community: Mesh is no longer moving with skeleton)
Binding a mesh that was not frozen and cleaned first causes odd results such as the mesh merging toward the first joint. (community: Unity forum: Smooth bind problem when importing from Maya)
assumptions: Before this: Delete history and freeze transformations on the mesh first.
Before this: The skeleton is oriented and in a clean rest pose (T-pose or A-pose).
Before this: Select the skeleton's root joint and the mesh.
steps.result: The character mesh is bound to the skeleton using a Skin Cluster deformer.
